name: asbuilt
description: Check that your AI-built web app works as intended: your assistant maps the features, you approve checks, and every pull request gets Pass, Fail or Not verified with screenshots.

interface.longDescription: AsBuilt checks that your AI-built web app works as intended. Your assistant reads your code and lists every feature in plain words; you correct the list and approve checks, so you never have to remember every feature yourself. A free GitHub Action then opens each preview deployment in a real browser on desktop and mobile and posts one pull request comment: Pass, Fail or Not verified for each check, with screenshots, coverage of your feature list, and a fix prompt to paste back. On a test site you approve, it can also run your full order flow with test accounts and Stripe's test card. Free and open source. No account, no hosted service, no telemetry. Installing the plugin never starts a test, and nothing is committed without your permission.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up AsBuilt on my repo. Map what my app does and show me the checks before adding anything.
